text: This run looked at the coding-agents page for technical evaluators in GCCs and IT services who want more developers to open the API docs. The hero (the saved copy from 2026-11-15) had gaps on A1-audience, A2-value, A3-proof, and A4-cta, which means it does not do those jobs yet. The writer tried three angles: Variant A focused on Indian jurisdiction, Variant B on live control, and Variant C on recovery and routing. Both Jev and Judge 2 placed variants A, B, and C into failed Gate 2 as near misses. Each variant improved the audit gaps, but both judges decided they did not pass because A7-checklist-item-1 fell.
